gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund columns: p4 Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints Debt Service and Capital Projects columns with no schedule. Debt Service: Taxes - property 3,393,826 + Taxes - city sales 509,809 + Development contribution 436,407 + Highway allocation funds 232,109 + Investment and interest income 172,661 = 4,744,812 (printed Total revenues). Capital Projects: Taxes - property 4,042,918 + Taxes - city sales 1,082,282 + Taxes - city sales additional 1/2% 5,670,645 + Licenses, permits and fees 1,152,481 + Development contribution 269,099 + City of LaVista - fire agreement 36,661 + Federal grants 156,185 + Highway allocation funds 266,811 + Investment and interest income 2,156,874 = 14,833,956 (printed). 64,676,120 + 4,744,812 + 14,833,956 = 84,254,888. (2) Different basis, no fix: the pp8-12 schedules are budget-and-actual (budgetary basis): General p8 Total revenues 60,761,935 vs p4 General 46,620,795 (+14,141,140); ARPA p9 159,110 = p4 159,110; Keno Lottery p10 984,970 vs p4 992,752 (-7,782); Papillion Landing p11 2,426,697 vs p4 2,424,965 (+1,732); Papio Bay p12 343,408 vs p4 344,868 (-1,460). 14,141,140 - 7,782 + 1,732 - 1,460 = 14,133,630; 84,254,888 - 14,133,630 = 70,121,258 = statement total. After the fix the schedule is 14,133,630 above the statement, all budgetary-basis difference.
